source.title: Figma Weave | AI-Powered Design Workflows, Built for Creative Pros
source.author: Unknown

athena.directive: Establish the Creative Liberation Engine as the definitive open-source, self-sovereign platform for advanced AI-driven creative workflows, empowering users with unparalleled control and flexibility over a federated AI model ecosystem and a customizable, intuitive design environment.
athena.rationale: Figma Weave demonstrates a compelling vision for integrating diverse AI models and professional design tools within a node-based workflow, culminating in simplified 'app modes' for collaboration. Our directive translates this inspiration into the Creative Liberation Engine's constitutional framework, prioritizing self-sovereignty (Article I), comprehensive quality (Article IV, IX), and automation (Article XX). By architecting a federated AI abstraction layer and a highly customizable design environment, we can exceed the capabilities of proprietary solutions while upholding our core principles.

options.title: Federated AI Model Abstraction Layer
options.description: Develop a core architectural component within the Creative Liberation Engine that acts as a universal abstraction layer for integrating diverse AI models (e.g., Google, OpenAI, Bytedance, etc.). This system will dynamically route requests to the best-suited model based on task, cost, or user preference, while presenting a unified API to higher-level creative tools. Emphasis on local-first execution and model registry for self-sovereignty.
options.tradeoffs: High initial architectural complexity and ongoing maintenance to support new models and API changes. Requires robust error handling and fallback mechanisms across disparate AI services.
options.architecture: Design a plug-in architecture for AI models, standardized input/output formats (e.g., custom protobufs, ONNX), a robust API gateway for intelligent routing, and a self-healing orchestration layer. Implement a model registry and discovery service for local and remote models. Prioritize containerization (e.g., Docker, WebAssembly) for model execution.
options.design: A 'Model Marketplace' UI within the Creative Liberation Engine where users can discover, integrate, and configure various AI models. Visual indicators for model capabilities, performance, and cost. Tools for A/B testing different models on the same input, with clear feedback on results and resource consumption.

options.title: Node-Based Visual Workflow Builder
options.description: Implement a powerful, intuitive node-based visual programming environment within the Creative Liberation Engine, mirroring Figma Weave's 'node-based platform.' This will allow users to construct complex AI-powered creative workflows by connecting various AI models, editing tools, and custom logic blocks into reusable pipelines.
options.tradeoffs: Significant UI/UX engineering effort to ensure usability and scalability for complex graphs. Potential for a steep learning curve for users unfamiliar with node-based interfaces, requiring comprehensive onboarding and documentation.
options.architecture: A robust graph-based execution engine capable of parallel processing and real-time data flow. A comprehensive component library for nodes (AI operations, image manipulations, data transformations, custom script blocks). Persistent workflow storage and versioning. Integration with BOLT for automatic code generation of new custom nodes.
options.design: A highly interactive canvas with drag-and-drop functionality for nodes, clear visual cues for data types and connections, real-time preview of intermediate outputs at each node, and customizable node appearance. Focus on discoverability of nodes, intelligent auto-completion for connections, and clear information hierarchy for complex graphs.

options.title: 'Workflow to App' UI Simplification Engine
options.description: Develop a feature that allows users to automatically generate simplified, task-specific user interfaces ('App Mode') from complex node-based workflows. This directly translates Figma Weave's concept of democratizing complex AI tools for team collaboration and broader accessibility.
options.tradeoffs: Complexity in accurately mapping arbitrary workflows to intuitive, simplified UIs without losing critical control. Potential for oversimplification or lack of desired customization in the generated interfaces.
options.architecture: A UI generation engine that parses workflow graphs, identifies key input/output parameters, and automatically constructs a simplified web or desktop interface. Requires a clear metadata schema for nodes to define UI elements (e.g., sliders, text inputs, file pickers, toggles). Integration with BOLT for generating production-ready UI code.
options.design: A 'Publish as App' wizard within the workflow builder, offering customizable templates and styling options for generated UIs. Responsive design for various screen sizes and devices. Focus on intuitive controls, clear labeling, and user-friendly error messages within the simplified interface.

options.title: Perceptual Quality & Control System
options.description: Implement advanced controls for 'Artistic Intelligence' that go beyond simple parameters, allowing users to precisely control the aesthetic and perceptual quality of AI-generated outputs. This addresses Figma Weave's emphasis on 'without compromising quality' and 'control the outcome,' crucial for creative professionals.
options.tradeoffs: Subjectivity of 'quality' makes objective measurement and universal control difficult. Requires significant R&D into AI evaluation metrics and user-friendly parameterization of complex latent spaces.
options.architecture: Develop a robust feedback loop mechanism for AI models, allowing users to provide qualitative feedback that can influence subsequent generations. Research and integrate advanced metrics for perceptual quality (e.g., FID, CLIP score, human preference models). Implement a 'Quality Gate' agent (VERA) for AI outputs, ensuring adherence to user-defined aesthetic standards.
options.design: Rich visual feedback tools for AI outputs (e.g., heatmaps of AI focus, semantic segmentation overlays, style transfer intensity controls, visual diffing). Intuitive UI elements for fine-tuning artistic parameters (e.g., sliders for 'stylistic coherence,' 'detail fidelity,' 'emotional tone'). A 'Perceptual Scorecard' for comparing different AI generations and visualizing their quality metrics.

options.title: Self-Sovereign AI Model Training & Fine-tuning
options.description: Empower users to train and fine-tune AI models directly within the Creative Liberation Engine using their own data, ensuring data privacy and intellectual property sovereignty (Article I). This moves beyond just consuming external models to owning and customizing them for specific creative needs.
options.tradeoffs: High computational requirements for local training, potentially requiring specialized hardware or distributed computing. Complexity of managing diverse machine learning environments and dependencies for users.
options.architecture: Local-first model training infrastructure (e.g., federated learning capabilities, support for various ML frameworks like PyTorch/TensorFlow without mandatory cloud dependencies). Secure data handling, encryption at rest and in transit. A modular 'Training Agent' (BOLT/IRIS) to manage compute resources, data pipelines, and model deployment.
options.design: A 'Model Studio' UI for managing datasets (upload, curate, preprocess), configuring training parameters (hyperparameters, epochs), visualizing training progress (loss curves, metrics, sample outputs), and deploying fine-tuned models. Clear privacy and data ownership declarations, with granular control over data usage.

options.title: Open-Source Creative Tool Suite Integration
options.description: Focus on deep, bidirectional integration with established open-source creative tools (e.g., GIMP, Krita, Blender, Inkscape) rather than solely building everything from scratch. This involves developing plugins, API bridges, and shared data formats to allow Creative Liberation Engine AI capabilities to augment existing professional tools, and vice-versa.
options.tradeoffs: Dependency on external tool APIs and development cycles, potentially leading to compatibility issues across versions. Requires significant effort to maintain seamless integration and avoid fragmentation.
options.architecture: Develop a universal plugin SDK for the Creative Liberation Engine that can target various creative applications. Standardized data interchange formats (e.g., OpenEXR, GLTF, SVG, PSD-like open formats) with robust converters. A dedicated 'Connector Agent' (RELAY/SIGNAL) for managing external tool communication, authentication, and data synchronization.
options.design: Seamless UI integration within the host applications, maintaining native look and feel where possible. Clear visual indicators of Creative Liberation Engine AI operations within the external tool's interface (e.g., dedicated menus, panels, or context-sensitive actions). A central Creative Liberation Engine dashboard for managing all connected tools and their integrations.
